name: Laravel 12 + MongoDB (NoSQL)
note: UNVERIFIED IN THE AUTHORING ENVIRONMENT. MongoDB cannot be emulated by SQLite, and these tests need a live mongod plus the ext-mongodb PHP extension (composer install of mongodb/laravel-mongodb fails without it), so every task requires the mongod binary and the runner reports them skipped on a machine without it. phpunit.xml points at MONGODB_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017, database app_mongo_test. Separately, the DB-free subset of SecurityControlsTest (auth gate, operator-key rejection, input validation, policy, hashing, pool caps, env, Dockerfile) was run once and mutation-checked with ext-mongodb ignored at install time; that run is not a substitute for a real run. Not covered because the kit ships no implementation: NOSQL-02 ObjectId validation, NOSQL-03 TLS, NOSQL-04 collection schema validation, NOSQL-05 index guard, AUTH-03 session fixation defence. CI-01/02 are pipeline gates.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.
assertions: an authenticated user can post and list their own events

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified where the control lives in kit code: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: NOSQL-01 operator keys ($where, $ne, $gt, $regex) and dotted keys are rejected at any depth of metadata
DATA-01 invalid severity, category length, latency and metadata type return 422
the client cannot choose the owner of an event
AUTH-02 users only see their own events and aggregates; policy allows only the owner
DATA-02 connection pool and timeouts are capped
models are MongoDB documents with a fillable whitelist

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
